title: Add epistemic doctrine to the opum-lore skill: status is not a verdict, bounded retrieval is advisory
description:
Two doctrine additions to skills/lore/SKILL.md (the public opum-lore plugin skill), proposed by opum-agent after extracting transferable guidance from the condorcet-research skill on mbpm2 rather than porting that skill itself (user-approved). Source: OPAG-121/OPAG-122 context, same 2026-09-13 proof-graph inspection that produced LCLI-476 through 479.

1. A document's status/attribution/task-completion is not a verdict about its content -- status: stable names a lifecycle stage, verified attribution names who touched it, neither substitutes for checking the claim's own evidence.
2. Bounded retrieval as usage guidance: retrieve a bounded navigation view and read exact sources before writing, rather than pulling whole targets; --max-tokens is advisory today, not a hard ceiling (lore context can return a target larger than the budget, marked truncated) -- this is LCLI-478's subject, document current behavior now and tighten wording once 478 lands.

acceptanceCriteria.text: skills/lore/SKILL.md states plainly that status/attribution/Done reflect lifecycle, not correctness, in the skill's own voice/format
skills/lore/SKILL.md documents that --max-tokens is advisory (not enforced) and recommends bounded navigation + exact-source reads over pulling whole targets
Wording is scoped to note current behavior, not to promise a hard budget that does not yet exist (revisit once LCLI-478 lands)

implementationNotes: Both doctrine additions written into skills/lore/SKILL.md under a new '## Read the evidence, not the status label' section (status/attribution/Done is lifecycle not correctness; bounded retrieval + --max-tokens is advisory today, revisit wording once LCLI-478 lands). Committed on branch docs/LCLI-480-skill-epistemic-doctrine, not yet merged -- this task record lives only on that branch until the PR lands, same as LCLI-473/475's precedent. Session recycled for context budget mid-release-work on an unrelated task (LCLI-475's 0.6.1 publish); picking this back up just needs opening/landing the PR, no further authoring.
